## Status colours in use

Each status label always gets the same colour, with its dot, so colour is never the only cue. The ratio is the status colour on its subtle fill, computed from the tokens.

## The five answers

| Question | Answer | Why |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Which color roles does it need? | Those and brand accents | Brand accents are part of the message. |
| How many emphasis levels do actions need? | Three | Primary, secondary, ghost. |
| How is the palette defined? | Neutrals and one brand ramp | Warm neutrals and one vivid ramp. |
| How saturated is the palette? | Vivid | Vivid color is the brand. |
| Where does color carry meaning first? | Brand moments | Color makes the launch moment. |

| `color.taupe.light.700` | #4D3A33 | <span class="ods-swatch" style="background:#4D3A33"></span> |
| `color.taupe.light.900` | #1F1411 | <span class="ods-swatch" style="background:#1F1411"></span> |

## Where it lands

- Button
- Input
- Control
- Badge
- Card
- Table
- Tabs
- Overlay

## When to use what

| Situation | Use | Not | Why |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| A selected row or item | color.surface.selected (brand tint) | Grey | Selection carries the brand. |
| An error message | color.status.danger and a short sentence | The brand magenta | Errors must not look like the brand. |
| A link | color.text.link, underlined | Color only | Underline keeps links clear on vivid color. |
| A status | Badge pill with a word | Color alone | A word keeps meaning on vivid backgrounds. |
| The action that completes the task | Button primary, large, one per section | Two primaries | One loud call to action per section. |
| An alternative or cancel | Button ghost | A second primary | The alternative must not compete. |
| Delete or remove | Button secondary, then confirm with Button danger | Button primary | Confirm before destroying data. |

## Status urgency

Status colours go up in urgency: info, then warning, then danger. Pick the level that matches the real risk. Never go up a level to get attention. Success sits outside the order.

`color.status.info.@` → `color.status.warning.@` → `color.status.danger.@`

## What each colour is for

| Token | What it is for | Not for |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `color.surface.canvas` | The page background behind everything. | Cards and panels on the page: `color.surface.default` |
| `color.surface.default` | The base fill for content. | The page behind content: `color.surface.canvas`<br />Menus and popovers above content: `color.surface.raised` |
| `color.surface.raised` | Fills that float above content. | Cards in the page flow: `color.surface.default` |
| `color.surface.sunken` | A recessed fill, a step below content. | A selected item: `color.surface.selected` |
| `color.surface.selected` | The fill of a selected or current item. | Hover: `color.surface.sunken`<br />The main action: `color.action.primary.@` |
| `color.surface.inverse` | A reversed fill for small, short-lived messages. | Large areas: `color.surface.default` |
| `color.surface.scrim` | The see-through layer behind a modal. | A solid fill: `color.surface.raised` |
| `color.text.primary` | Body text and headings. | Text on the main action: `color.text.on-action`<br />Text on an inverse fill: `color.text.inverse` |
| `color.text.secondary` | Supporting text. | The main content: `color.text.primary` |
| `color.text.muted` | The quietest text. | Anything people must read to act: `color.text.secondary`<br />A disabled control: `color.disabled.text` |
| `color.text.inverse` | Text on an inverse fill. | Text on the page: `color.text.primary` |
| `color.text.on-light` | Text on any fill whose tone is light, in either mode: the light mode's body text. | Text on the page's own surfaces: `color.text.primary` |
| `color.text.on-dark` | Text on any fill whose tone is dark, in either mode: white. | Text on the page's own surfaces: `color.text.primary` |
| `color.text.on-action` | Text and icons on the main action's fill. | Text on the page: `color.text.primary` |
| `color.text.on-danger` | Text on the danger fill: its tone's main text. | Text on the main action: `color.text.on-action` |
| `color.text.link` | Links in running text. | Buttons: `color.action.primary.@` |
| `color.border.default` | Quiet edges and dividers. Decorative, so it has no contrast minimum. | The edge of a control people must find: `color.border.strong` |
| `color.border.strong` | The edge of a control people must find. | A divider: `color.border.default` |
| `color.border.focus` | The focus ring. | A selected item: `color.surface.selected` |
| `color.border.selected` | The edge that marks a selected item, beside its fill, so selection is never colour alone. | Keyboard focus: `color.border.focus`<br />The fill of a selected item: `color.surface.selected` |
| `color.action.primary.@` | The one main action in a view. | A second action in the same view: `color.action.secondary.@`<br />Links in text: `color.text.link`<br />News or status: `color.status.info.@` |
| `color.action.primary.hover` | The main action under the pointer. | The resting state: `color.action.primary.@` |
| `color.action.secondary.@` | The fill of other actions. | The main action: `color.action.primary.@` |
| `color.action.secondary.hover` | Other actions under the pointer. | The resting state: `color.action.secondary.@` |
| `color.action.danger.@` | The fill of a destructive commit: the confirm of a delete. | The first step of a delete: `color.action.secondary.@`<br />An error message: `color.status.danger.@` |
| `color.action.danger.hover` | The danger fill on hover. | The resting fill: `color.action.danger.@` |
| `color.status.info.@` | Neutral news: something changed and no action is needed. The lowest level of the urgency order. | Something needs a check: `color.status.warning.@`<br />The main action: `color.action.primary.@` |
| `color.status.info.subtle` | The fill behind info status. | Large page areas: `color.surface.default` |
| `color.status.warning.@` | Caution: something may go wrong or needs a check, and it can be fixed. | An error, or an action that cannot be undone: `color.status.danger.@`<br />News that needs no action: `color.status.info.@` |
| `color.status.warning.subtle` | The fill behind warning status. | Large page areas: `color.surface.default` |
| `color.status.danger.@` | Real risk: errors, failed checks, actions that cannot be undone. The top of the urgency order. Overuse wears it out. | Caution or advice: `color.status.warning.@`<br />Getting attention: `color.status.info.@` |
| `color.status.danger.subtle` | The fill behind danger status. | Large page areas: `color.surface.default` |
| `color.status.success.@` | Confirmation that something worked. It sits outside the urgency order. | The main action: `color.action.primary.@`<br />Brand colour: `color.action.primary.@` |
| `color.status.success.subtle` | The fill behind success status. | Large page areas: `color.surface.default` |
| `color.category.1.@` | Category 1: tells one item or series from another. It carries no meaning. | Status or risk: `color.status.warning.@`<br />Tag text: `color.text.primary` |
| `color.category.1.subtle` | Category 1: the fill of a tag. | A status badge: `color.status.info.subtle` |
| `color.category.2.@` | Category 2: tells one item or series from another. It carries no meaning. | Status or risk: `color.status.warning.@`<br />Tag text: `color.text.primary` |
| `color.category.2.subtle` | Category 2: the fill of a tag. | A status badge: `color.status.info.subtle` |
| `color.category.3.@` | Category 3: tells one item or series from another. It carries no meaning. | Status or risk: `color.status.warning.@`<br />Tag text: `color.text.primary` |
| `color.category.3.subtle` | Category 3: the fill of a tag. | A status badge: `color.status.info.subtle` |
| `color.category.4.@` | Category 4: tells one item or series from another. It carries no meaning. | Status or risk: `color.status.warning.@`<br />Tag text: `color.text.primary` |
| `color.category.4.subtle` | Category 4: the fill of a tag. | A status badge: `color.status.info.subtle` |
| `color.category.5.@` | Category 5: tells one item or series from another. It carries no meaning. | Status or risk: `color.status.warning.@`<br />Tag text: `color.text.primary` |
| `color.category.5.subtle` | Category 5: the fill of a tag. | A status badge: `color.status.info.subtle` |
| `color.disabled.text` | Text and icons of a control that cannot be used right now. | Quiet text that still works: `color.text.muted` |
| `color.disabled.surface` | The fill of a control that cannot be used right now. | A quiet fill that still works: `color.surface.sunken` |
| `color.disabled.border` | The edge of a control that cannot be used right now. | An enabled control: `color.border.strong` |

## Pairs at a glance

Which colour may sit on which fill, and the contrast it keeps there in every brand and mode. Text pairs by tone: every fill says whether it is light or dark, and the text on it is `color.text.on-light` or `color.text.on-dark`. The page's own text is the set of its own surfaces. The harness checks every pair.

| Token | Sits on | Contrast |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `color.text.primary` | The page's own fills: `color.surface.canvas`, `color.surface.default`, `color.surface.raised`, `color.surface.sunken`, `color.surface.selected`, `color.surface.inverse`, `color.action.primary.@`, `color.action.primary.hover`, `color.action.danger.@`, `color.action.danger.hover`, `color.action.secondary.@`, `color.action.secondary.hover`, `color.status.info.subtle`, `color.status.warning.subtle`, `color.status.danger.subtle`, `color.status.success.subtle` | 4.5:1 |
| `color.text.secondary` | The page's own fills: `color.surface.canvas`, `color.surface.default`, `color.surface.raised`, `color.surface.sunken`, `color.surface.selected` | 4.5:1 |
| `color.text.muted` | The page's own fills: `color.surface.canvas`, `color.surface.default`, `color.surface.raised`, `color.surface.sunken`, `color.surface.selected` | 4.5:1 |
| `color.text.inverse` | `color.surface.inverse` | 4.5:1 |
| `color.text.on-light` | Fills whose tone is light: `color.surface.canvas`, `color.surface.default`, `color.surface.raised`, `color.surface.sunken`, `color.surface.selected`, `color.surface.inverse`, `color.action.primary.@`, `color.action.primary.hover`, `color.action.danger.@`, `color.action.danger.hover`, `color.action.secondary.@`, `color.action.secondary.hover`, `color.status.info.subtle`, `color.status.warning.subtle`, `color.status.danger.subtle`, `color.status.success.subtle` | 4.5:1 |
| `color.text.on-dark` | Fills whose tone is dark: `color.surface.canvas`, `color.surface.default`, `color.surface.raised`, `color.surface.sunken`, `color.surface.selected`, `color.surface.inverse`, `color.action.primary.@`, `color.action.primary.hover`, `color.action.danger.@`, `color.action.danger.hover`, `color.action.secondary.@`, `color.action.secondary.hover`, `color.status.info.subtle`, `color.status.warning.subtle`, `color.status.danger.subtle`, `color.status.success.subtle` | 4.5:1 |
| `color.text.on-action` | `color.action.primary.@`, `color.action.primary.hover` | 4.5:1 |
| `color.text.on-danger` | `color.action.danger.@`, `color.action.danger.hover` | 4.5:1 |
| `color.text.link` | The page's own fills: `color.surface.canvas`, `color.surface.default`, `color.surface.raised`, `color.surface.sunken`, `color.surface.selected` | 4.5:1 |
| `color.border.strong` | The page's own fills: `color.surface.canvas`, `color.surface.default`, `color.surface.raised`, `color.surface.sunken`, `color.surface.selected` | 3:1 |
| `color.border.focus` | The page's own fills: `color.surface.canvas`, `color.surface.default`, `color.surface.raised`, `color.surface.sunken`, `color.surface.selected`, `color.surface.inverse` | 3:1 |
| `color.border.selected` | `color.surface.canvas`, `color.surface.default`, `color.surface.selected` | 3:1 |
| `color.action.primary.@` | `color.surface.canvas`, `color.surface.default` | 3:1 |
| `color.status.info.@` | `color.surface.canvas`, `color.surface.default`, `color.status.info.subtle` | 4.5:1 |
| `color.status.warning.@` | `color.surface.canvas`, `color.surface.default`, `color.status.warning.subtle` | 4.5:1 |
| `color.status.danger.@` | `color.surface.canvas`, `color.surface.default`, `color.status.danger.subtle` | 4.5:1 |
| `color.status.success.@` | `color.surface.canvas`, `color.surface.default`, `color.status.success.subtle` | 4.5:1 |
| `color.category.1.@` | `color.surface.canvas`, `color.surface.default` | 3:1 |
| `color.category.2.@` | `color.surface.canvas`, `color.surface.default` | 3:1 |
| `color.category.3.@` | `color.surface.canvas`, `color.surface.default` | 3:1 |
| `color.category.4.@` | `color.surface.canvas`, `color.surface.default` | 3:1 |
| `color.category.5.@` | `color.surface.canvas`, `color.surface.default` | 3:1 |
| `color.disabled.text` | `color.disabled.surface` | WCAG 1.4.3 does not ask for contrast on controls that cannot be used. |

## The tone of each fill

Every fill says whether it is light or dark. Text on it is `color.text.on-light` on a light fill, `color.text.on-dark` on a dark one. "Everything" means text.primary, text.secondary, text.muted, link, icon, border, focus.

| Fill | Light mode | Dark mode | What sits on it |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `color.surface.canvas` | light | dark | Everything |
| `color.surface.default` | light | dark | Everything |
| `color.surface.raised` | light | dark | Everything |
| `color.surface.sunken` | light | dark | Everything |
| `color.surface.selected` | light | dark (waits for OD-223) | Everything |
| `color.surface.inverse` | dark | light | text.primary, icon, focus |
| `color.action.primary.@` | dark | light (waits for OD-225) | text.primary |
| `color.action.primary.hover` | dark | light | text.primary |
| `color.action.danger.@` | dark | light | text.primary |
| `color.action.danger.hover` | dark | light | text.primary |
| `color.action.secondary.@` | light | dark | text.primary, icon |
| `color.action.secondary.hover` | light | dark | text.primary, icon |
| `color.status.info.subtle` | light | dark | text.primary, icon |
| `color.status.warning.subtle` | light | dark | text.primary, icon |
| `color.status.danger.subtle` | light | dark | text.primary, icon |
| `color.status.success.subtle` | light | dark | text.primary, icon |

- `color.surface.selected` in dark mode waits for OD-223: Its ramp has no step that passes yet (text.muted 3.87:1); whole ramps add one.
- `color.action.primary.@` in dark mode waits for OD-225: In dark mode the brand's pink is close to the danger red (under 10 apart); which one moves is a brand decision.
